stem.text: Two parallel metal plates are connected to a d.c. supply, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram: a cell connected by wires to two parallel metal plates, with a point P marked between the plates.

stem.text: The two plates are moved towards each other at constant speed.
It may be assumed that the electric field between the plates is uniform.
Point P is mid-way between the two plates.
Which graph shows the variation with time $t$ of the electric field strength $E$ at point P?

A.alt: Graph of E against t: a curve starts near the top of the E axis, stays high and then falls towards the t axis.

B.alt: Graph of E against t: a curve starts on the E axis, falls steeply and then levels off.

C.alt: Graph of E against t: a curve starts above the origin on the E axis, rises and levels off.

D.alt: Graph of E against t: a curve starts above the origin on the E axis and rises with increasing steepness.
